name: Original Balance Positive
description: The original loan balance at origination must be strictly greater than zero.

name: Interest Rate Bounds
description: Annual interest rate at origination must fall within a realistic mortgage rate boundary.

name: Allowed Credit Score Bands
description: Credit score band must match underwriting guidelines.

name: Allowed LTV Bands
description: Origination Loan-to-Value band must match underwriting guidelines.

name: Allowed DTI Bands
description: Origination Debt-to-Income band must match underwriting guidelines.

name: Allowed Loan Purposes
description: Loan purpose must match valid categories.

name: Allowed Occupancy Types
description: Property occupancy type must match valid categories.

name: Allowed Property Types
description: Property architecture type must match valid categories.

name: Unique Loan Origination Records
description: Each loan_id must appear exactly once in the loan static attributes database.

name: Current Balance Non-Negative
description: The outstanding principal balance in any performance month must be non-negative.

name: Current Balance Bounds
description: The outstanding principal balance must not exceed the origination balance.

name: Original Balance Constant
description: Original balance of a loan must remain constant across all of its monthly historical records.

name: Reporting Date Sequence
description: The reporting month must be greater than or equal to the loan origination month.

name: Loan Age Non-Negative
description: Elapsed months since origination (loan age) cannot be negative.

name: Remaining Term Non-Negative
description: Remaining scheduled amortization term in months cannot be negative.

name: Month Index Sequence
description: Month index must start at 0 at origination and increase sequentially by 1 for each reporting period.

name: Chronological Reporting Months
description: Reporting month must increase chronologically without gaps or regressions within each loan history.

name: Reporting Date Max Limit
description: Reporting month must not be later than the configured maximum reporting date.

name: Allowed DPD Buckets
description: Days Past Due (DPD) must match defined industry reporting buckets.

name: Current Status DPD Check
description: A status of 'Current' must correspond to exactly zero days past due.

name: Delinquent Status DPD Check
description: A status of 'Delinquent' must correspond to greater than zero days past due.

name: Default Status DPD Check
description: A status of 'Default' must correspond to the maximum delinquency bucket of 90 DPD.

name: Prepaid Status DPD Check
description: A prepaid loan must have zero days past due.

name: Logical Delinquency Progression
description: Delinquency transitions should roll sequentially (e.g., 0 to 30, 30 to 60, 60 to 90). Skipped DPD buckets raise warnings.

name: Terminal Prepaid Status Check
description: Prepaid status is terminal; no monthly observations can occur after a loan is prepaid.

name: Terminal Default Status Check
description: Default status is terminal; no monthly observations can occur after a loan defaults.

name: Prepayment Flag Consistency
description: If prepayment_flag is set to 1, the loan's current_status must be Prepaid.

name: Default Flag Consistency
description: If default_flag is set to 1, the loan's current_status must be Default.

name: Prepaid Balance Validation
description: A prepaid loan must have a balance close to zero.

name: Default Loss Severity Check
description: A default record must be associated with a valid loss severity band (Low, Medium, High).

name: Non-Default Loss Severity Check
description: Active or prepaid loans must have loss_severity_band set to None.

name: Modification Flag Binary
description: Modification flag must be either 0 or 1.

name: Prepayment Flag Binary
description: Prepayment flag must be either 0 or 1.

name: Default Flag Binary
description: Default flag must be either 0 or 1.

name: Modification Delinquency Requirement
description: Loan modifications normally occur for delinquent accounts (DPD >= 60). Modifications on current/mildly delinquent loans trigger a warning.

name: Allowed Document Statuses
description: Document status must be Complete, Pending, or Missing.

name: Missing Document Exception Trigger
description: If the document status is Missing, an exception must be required.

name: Missing Document Exception Classification
description: If the document status is Missing, exception_type must indicate Documentation Gap.

description: Supplying database system must be a registered source.
